import datetime
from unittest.mock import patch
import schedule


def test_tag_filter_and_copy():
    scheduler=schedule.Scheduler()
    first=schedule.Job(1,scheduler);first.tags={"a"}
    second=schedule.Job(1,scheduler);second.tags={"b"}
    scheduler.jobs=[first,second]
    assert scheduler.get_jobs("a")==[first]
    assert scheduler.get_jobs("missing")==[]
    selected=scheduler.get_jobs();selected.clear()
    assert scheduler.jobs==[first,second]


def test_cancel_only_requested_and_ignore_absent():
    scheduler=schedule.Scheduler()
    first=schedule.Job(1,scheduler);second=schedule.Job(1,scheduler)
    scheduler.jobs=[first,second]
    scheduler.cancel_job(first)
    assert scheduler.jobs==[second]
    scheduler.cancel_job(first)
    assert scheduler.jobs==[second]


def test_overdue_strict_boundary_and_none():
    clock=datetime.datetime(2025,1,2,3,4,5)
    job=schedule.Job(1)
    assert not job._is_overdue(clock)
    job.cancel_after=clock
    assert not job._is_overdue(clock)
    assert job._is_overdue(clock+datetime.timedelta(microseconds=1))
    assert not job._is_overdue(clock-datetime.timedelta(microseconds=1))


def test_should_run_inclusive_boundary():
    clock=datetime.datetime(2025,1,2,3,4,5)
    job=schedule.Job(1)
    job.next_run=clock
    with patch("schedule.datetime.datetime") as mocked:
        mocked.now.return_value=clock
        assert job.should_run
        mocked.now.return_value=clock-datetime.timedelta(microseconds=1)
        assert not job.should_run
        mocked.now.return_value=clock+datetime.timedelta(microseconds=1)
        assert job.should_run
